name: create_relationship
description: Create a new relationship between two characters in the same canon. This establishes the basic relationship type and summary with claim_count=0. After creating, use add_relationship_claim to add specific evidence. This will fail if a relationship already exists between these characters in this canon.

character_a.description: Name of the first character in the relationship

character_b.description: Name of the second character in the relationship

canon.description: Canon this relationship belongs to (e.g., 'main', 'film', 'legends'). Both characters must exist in this canon.

summary.description: Brief one-sentence summary of the relationship
